Hi all, I've put together a demo version of "Destroyer: Invasion" by MFAFB Games. It's a limited demo, offering four (of thirty) levels - with a New Game+ version of all four if you beat them on normal.

The game is based on a couple of my retro favorites, "The Dreadnaught Factor" and "Xevious". You must stop huge alien ships from attacking your new colony, and you have 6 fighter drones to do it with. You can keep making passes at the ships until you run out of fighters, or until the ship reaches the planet and ends all life there. Take out enough targets to overload the ship and destroy it.

The game has full controller support, use Fire1 (left mouse, button 1, CTRL) to shoot lasers and Fire2 (RMB, button 2, ALT) to launch bombs. W/S (forward/backward) to control ship speed, A/D (left/right) to move side to side. (obviously)

You can download the demo on our website or with the direct link here.
